name: sesh
description: Browse, annotate, and resume saved Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Browse, annotate, and resume saved Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions.
[Open Sesh panel](command:sesh.open)

A full editor tab opens with your session list, search, filters, and transcript preview.

Browse, annotate, and resume saved Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions.
[Open Sesh panel](command:sesh.open)

sesh.openOnActivation.description: Open the Sesh panel automatically on extension activation.

sesh.transcriptLimit.description: Max messages loaded when viewing a transcript.

sesh.archiveTranscripts.description: Gzip-archive transcripts to ~/.sesh/transcripts/ on first index.

sesh.outcomeInferenceDays.description: Days of inactivity after which a session is auto-marked 'abandoned' (user-marked outcomes always win).

sesh.indexBackfillMode.description: Eager: background-index all sessions at activation. Lazy: index a session on first view.

sesh.statusBarShowCost.description: Show today's spend in the status bar.

sesh.tabs.knowledge.description: Show the Knowledge tab in the Sesh panel. Off by default — enable in Sesh's Settings tab once you've turned on embeddings.

sesh.tabs.ideas.description: Show the Ideas tab in the Sesh panel. Off by default — enable in Sesh's Settings tab once you've turned on idea mining.

sesh.tabs.insights.description: Show the Insights tab in the Sesh panel.

sesh.tabs.reviewer.description: Show the Reviewer tab in the Sesh panel.

sesh.pickUpBanner.description: Show the 'Pick up where you left off' banner above the session list.

sesh.pickUpScope.description: Which sessions feed the 'Pick up where you left off' banner. 'workspace' (default) restricts to sessions inside the current workspace's git repo; 'global' uses every session you've had.

sesh.gitIndexerEnabled.description: Index commits and link sessions to commits at activation. Powers the Reviewer tab and auto-shipped/auto-reverted outcome inference. Off by default — enable when you want the Reviewer tab populated. Reload window after enabling.

sesh.embeddingsEnabled.description: Enable local semantic indexing of session transcripts. Powers the Knowledge tab. Off by default — enabling triggers a ~30 MB model download on first use. Reload window after enabling.

sesh.embeddingsAutoStart.description: Automatically index embeddings at activation. Default off because the local @huggingface/transformers runtime can crash the extension host on some Electron builds. When off, run the 'Sesh: Reindex embeddings' command manually to index.

sesh.embedder.description: Which embedder to use. 'local' runs entirely on-device via @huggingface/transformers (recommended). 'ollama' targets a local Ollama server. 'cloud' targets an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

sesh.embedderModel.description: Override embedder model. Leave blank for the embedder's default (Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for local, nomic-embed-text for ollama, text-embedding-3-small for cloud).

sesh.embedderApiKey.description: API key for the cloud embedder. Stored in plaintext in VSCode settings — only set if you accept that risk.

sesh.embedderApiUrl.description: Override the embedder endpoint URL. Blank uses the embedder's default.

sesh.ideaMining.description: Mine intent-bearing user messages into the Ideas tab graveyard. Off by default — enable to populate the Ideas tab. Reload window after enabling.

sesh.ideaMiningSinceDays.description: Only mine ideas from sessions active within this many days.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:webview: cd webview && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run prebuilds:fetch && npm run build
